heroHeadline: Migrants Return to El Trampolín Beach Hours After Clearance, Forcing Second Eviction
heroSubtitle: Roughly 500 people relocated from Ceuta's El Trampolín beach camp drift back within hours, prompting a second eviction attempt as Mayor Vivas says relocating migrants elsewhere in Ceuta 'does not show a willingness to solve the problem'; Migration Minister Elma Saiz outlines plans to expand reception capacity toward 4,000 places.
